searchText: Got a spam DM from <@456226577798135808> <@!203220829473996800> mind giving em the 👢? Yup ah theres multiple, great I got one from <@456226577798135808> Yes, we just got spammed by a lot of new accounts joining the server I recommend this bot if its a recurring problem https://altdentifier.com/, has anti-raid protection fun, they've found us You can turn on some light verification before people are allowed to join I believe Doesnt block them from DMing unfortunately Discord has ignored this issue for years now :/ I think you can disable messages from people on the same server. But similarly, I don't think anyone really wants to block conversation. Bots are terrible though And I don't want to force anyone to wait X minutes/hours to post something either, keeping this discord open is important I'll ban the new 1-minute accounts, hope it doesn't happen again All banned. I don't want to see that ban hammer gif again, discord moderation is terribly inefficient Really is terrible, the bot I linked has a "If X users join in X minutes, consider it a raid and auto-ban all" Sometimes normal users get caught in it though, situation is mega annoying Yes, and hackers could make the bot a little smarter too with near 0 effort. I wonder if it's worth fighting. Shouldn't even call them hackers. More like pathetic scammers just might become a recurring problem the easier it is for them ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
